# lol.trq.orpheus

> A general-purpose Java 17 music library: what is playing, playback controls, cover colours and synced lyrics, from
> Windows media sessions, Linux MPRIS, macOS Now Playing (experimental) and data pushed in by the program. No
> dependencies, MIT. Only the optional Spotify module uses the network.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/README.md): requirements, artifacts, usage, privacy, limitations
- [Platforms](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/docs/platforms.md): what each system provides, app ids, limits, transforming the jars
- [Spotify](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/docs/spotify.md): the optional Web API source, scopes, request rates
- [Harness](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/docs/harness.md): the live checks and how to run them
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/BENCHMARKS.md): JMH numbers and measured targets
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): mental model, patterns that matter, traps
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): commit and test conventions
- [NOTICE](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/NOTICE.md): third-party licenses
- [DISCLAIMER](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md): non-affiliation, private interfaces, copyright of lyrics and art

## Core source

- [Orpheus](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Orpheus.java): entry point, builder, threads, command routing
- [Engine](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/internal/Engine.java): selection, merging, position anchoring, events
- [Playback](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Playback.java), [Track](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Track.java), [Timeline](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Timeline.java), [Snapshot](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Snapshot.java): the immutable model
- [Controls](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/Controls.java): commands with typed results
- [AppRules](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/AppRules.java): which applications are visible
- [Source](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/Source.java), [SessionUpdate](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/SessionUpdate.java), [Transport](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/Transport.java): what a source implements
- [PushSource](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/source/PushSource.java): a source fed by the program
- [Lrc](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/Lrc.java), [Lyrics](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/Lyrics.java), [LyricsMatcher](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/LyricsMatcher.java), [LocalLyrics](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/LocalLyrics.java), [AudioTags](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/AudioTags.java): lyrics
- [CoverDecoder](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/cover/CoverDecoder.java), [Palette](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/cover/Palette.java), [CoverCache](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/cover/CoverCache.java): covers
- [NativeFiles](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/internal/NativeFiles.java): verified extraction of bundled native files

## Platform source

- [WindowsSessions](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/windows/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/windows/WindowsSessions.java), [Bridge](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/windows/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/windows/Bridge.java), [Blob](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/windows/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/windows/Blob.java): Windows, Java side
- [sessions.rs](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/native/orpheus-windows/src/sessions.rs), [jni.rs](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/native/orpheus-windows/src/jni.rs), [wire.rs](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/native/orpheus-windows/src/wire.rs): Windows, native side
- [MprisSource](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/MprisSource.java), [Bus](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/dbus/Bus.java), [Wire](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/dbus/Wire.java), [Message](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/dbus/Message.java): Linux
- [NativeMpris](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/linux/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/linux/NativeMpris.java), [mpris.rs](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/native/orpheus-linux/src/mpris.rs), [wire.rs](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/native/orpheus-linux/src/wire.rs): Linux through the native library
- [MacNowPlaying](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/macos/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/macos/MacNowPlaying.java): macOS
- [SystemSessions](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/system/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/system/SystemSessions.java): picks by operating system

## Examples

- [OrpheusTest](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/test/java/lol/trq/orpheus/OrpheusTest.java): start, commands, push source, stop
- [EngineTest](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/test/java/lol/trq/orpheus/internal/EngineTest.java): selection, merging, position, lyrics and cover rules
- [LrcTest](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/core/src/test/java/lol/trq/orpheus/lyrics/LrcTest.java): lyric formats and timing
- [Scenarios](https://github.com/trq-lol/lol.trq.orpheus/blob/main/harness/src/main/java/lol/trq/orpheus/harness/Scenarios.java): live use against a real session
